design.selection: Require no hard-safety cases or execution errors. Qualify if safe completions increase >=1 with G500 not decreasing, OR safe completions unchanged and G500 increases >=2. Rank qualified settings by safe completions, G500, lower mean endpoint error; final tie uses declared setting order.
design.stop: No qualifying setting: stop after48. Otherwise exactly24 transfer episodes, no parameter recombination or retuning. Reject global adoption if transfer loses safe completion, adds hard-safety failure, or fails to improve either completion or G500 in total.
design.scientific_scope: Previously examined development conditions, one seed. Transfer is not independent validation or a population probability.
design.constraints: No changes to physics, observations, robot resources, successful arrival, settling, safety constraints or G500 limits. Motion prior is estimator acceptance only; safety velocity bound unchanged.

primary: Original task completion AND original hard safety; G500 retained separately
completion: HOLD + speed <=.005 for40frames and Euclidean endpoint<=.12m, unchanged
information: Own/one-hop observations plus existing shared team phase supervisor; no new truth access
